users

CREATE TABLE users (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(100), 
	is_admin BOOLEAN, 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_username ON users (username)
api_keys

CREATE TABLE api_keys (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	key_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	key_prefix VARCHAR(11) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	scopes TEXT, 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	last_used DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
audit_log

CREATE TABLE audit_log (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR, 
	action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	detail TEXT, 
	ip_address VARCHAR(45), 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_log_action ON audit_log (action)
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_log_created_at ON audit_log (created_at)
basics_collections

CREATE TABLE basics_collections (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
categories

CREATE TABLE categories (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	icon VARCHAR(50), 
	color VARCHAR(7), 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	is_default BOOLEAN, 
	created_by VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
invite_codes

CREATE TABLE invite_codes (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	used_by VARCHAR, 
	is_used BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	expires_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(used_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_invite_codes_code ON invite_codes (code)
meals

CREATE TABLE meals (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	base_servings INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_url VARCHAR(2000), 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_archived BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_meals_name ON meals (name)
CREATE INDEX ix_meals_is_archived ON meals (is_archived)
shopping_lists

CREATE TABLE shopping_lists (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	color VARCHAR(7), 
	icon VARCHAR(50), 
	is_archived BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
bulk_add_receipts

CREATE TABLE bulk_add_receipts (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	list_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_bulk_add_user_request UNIQUE (user_id, request_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(list_id) REFERENCES shopping_lists (id)
)
ingredients

CREATE TABLE ingredients (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	normalized_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	default_unit VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	default_category_id VARCHAR, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_archived BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(default_category_id) REFERENCES categories (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_ingredients_normalized_name ON ingredients (normalized_name)
CREATE INDEX ix_ingredients_is_archived ON ingredients (is_archived)
item_category_memory

CREATE TABLE item_category_memory (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	item_name_lower VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	category_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	usage_count INTEGER, 
	last_used DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_item_category UNIQUE (item_name_lower, category_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES categories (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_item_category_memory_item_name_lower ON item_category_memory (item_name_lower)
CREATE INDEX ix_item_memory_lookup ON item_category_memory (item_name_lower, usage_count)
list_items

CREATE TABLE list_items (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	list_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	quantity FLOAT, 
	unit VARCHAR(30), 
	category_id VARCHAR, 
	checked BOOLEAN, 
	checked_by VARCHAR, 
	checked_at DATETIME, 
	added_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT, 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(list_id) REFERENCES shopping_lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES categories (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(checked_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(added_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_list_items_list_sort ON list_items (list_id, checked, sort_order)
list_members

CREATE TABLE list_members (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	list_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(20), 
	joined_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_list_member UNIQUE (list_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(list_id) REFERENCES shopping_lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
basics_items

CREATE TABLE basics_items (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	collection_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	ingredient_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	quantity FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	unit VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	category_id VARCHAR, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	scales_with_servings BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_archived BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_basics_ingredient UNIQUE (collection_id, ingredient_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(collection_id) REFERENCES basics_collections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(ingredient_id) REFERENCES ingredients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES categories (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_basics_items_is_archived ON basics_items (is_archived)
CREATE INDEX ix_basics_items_order ON basics_items (collection_id, sort_order)
meal_ingredients

CREATE TABLE meal_ingredients (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	meal_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	ingredient_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	quantity FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	unit VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	category_id VARCHAR, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	scales_with_servings BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_meal_ingredient UNIQUE (meal_id, ingredient_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(meal_id) REFERENCES meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(ingredient_id) REFERENCES ingredients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES categories (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_meal_ingredients_order ON meal_ingredients (meal_id, sort_order)
